IC1: Newly diagnosed [OR] and untreated sputum smear [AND] positive tuberculosis patient
IC2: Pulmonary lesion [AND] consistent with TB by radiological examination
IC3: Positive sputum culture, identification of bacterial type confirmed Mycobacterium tuberculosis. MGIT drug sensitivity test (DST) [AND] results are sensitive of the first-line drugs (isoniazid [OR], streptomycin [OR], rifampicin [OR] and ethambutol).
IC6: Serum [OR] or plasma aminotransferases (AST [OR], ALT) less than 3 times the upper limit of normal
IC7: Serum [OR] or plasma total bilirubin less than or equal to 2.5 times the upper limit of normal
IC8: Serum [OR] or plasma creatinine level less than or equal to 2 times the upper limit of normal
IC9: Serum [OR] or plasma potassium level greater than or equal to 3.5 meq/L
IC10: Hemoglobin level of 7.0 g/dL or greater
IC12: For women of childbearing potential,  [AND] a negative pregnancy test is required during screening
IC14: Willingness and ability to attend scheduled follow-up visits and undergo study assessments.
